scenarios.prompt: A live store catalog returns localized product metadata for a cosmetic and a subscription. Trace offer eligibility, purchase request state and entitlement mapping without granting from UI state.

criteria.catalog: offer_id/catalog revision and provider product mapping are explicit.
criteria.lifecycle: Pending/cancelled/failed/deferred/successful provider states remain distinct and live price metadata comes from the store.
criteria.ownership: Transaction truth stays with provider APIs; entitlement-grant/restore-purchase own value settlement and restoration.
